g.text: FFT area: microphone count × window length × precision
192 ksample/s · 20–40 kHz · 60° × 60° FOV · 3° grid · one window/map · all registers and UART counted
Dots: measured whole-top synthesis. Lines: fitted estimates; shading ±25.0% screening allowance.
Only selected combinations were synthesized. Fixed paired-real, shared FFT architecture; no physical/timing signoff.
